h2: Handyman Sanur: Small Repairs Done Right in One Visit
intro: Sanur's established villas and long-term homes quietly accumulate small faults: sticking doors, corroded handles, torn mosquito screens. As a Handyman Sanur service, Bali Fix bundles those fixes into one visit so villa owners in Sindhu, Semawang and beyond don't have to chase five different tradespeople across the island.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Old Villas and What It Does to Your Hardware
sections.text: In Sindhu and Mertasari the sea breeze reaches every window frame, hinge and tap within months of installation. By year fifteen or twenty on a Sanur Kauh property, original PVC fittings have gone brittle under constant UV exposure, and steel hardware shows visible pitting. A clean section replacement beats patching a cracked pipe; a new set of hinges outlasts three rounds of oiling. That is why we assess the whole assembly before touching a single screw.

sections.h3: The Jobs We Actually See Around Sanur
sections.text: Most calls arrive as combinations: a bedroom door catching on its frame, a bathroom lock needing two hands to turn, silicone gone black in the shower recess, a curtain rail sagging because one bracket pulled free. Mosquito screens tear at the corners where mesh meets the aluminium track. Shelves installed during the original build shift as the villa settles. We bring the right screws, adhesive and brackets so nothing gets held together with tape.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp Before You Book
sections.text: A clear photo of the problem — door gap, corroded hinge, mouldy silicone line — plus one sentence about what is happening gives us enough for a fair quote. Mention your lane or area if you know it; travel time varies between Batujimbar and the beachfront stretches. Pricing depends entirely on the job and parts needed, so we confirm after seeing your photos rather than guessing over text.

Two or three times a year, run a finger along every silicone joint in wet areas — if it lifts or feels chalky, re-apply before mould sets in. Hinges and locks near the beach benefit from a dry-cloth wipe-down to knock off salt residue; a drop of light oil keeps them moving. If your villa draws well water, flush the lines monthly so brackish sediment does not clog filters or scale up the heater element.

faq.q: Do you handle multiple small jobs in a single visit?
faq.a: Yes — that is the whole point. Send photos of everything on WhatsApp and we will bundle it into one trip rather than making you book separately.

faq.q: How do I get a price without visiting first?
faq.a: It depends on the specific repair and any parts required; send clear photos on WhatsApp and we will confirm a quote directly from there.

faq.q: Which lanes around Sanur are covered?
faq.a: All of Sanur including Kaja, Kauh, Sindhu, Semawang, Mertasari and Batujimbar, plus the quieter beachfront lanes in between.
